trajectory_matrix.A-code: implementation-centric: find bugs in the code as written
trajectory_matrix.B-economic: economic attacker: assume the protocol is economically exploitable and find the imbalance
trajectory_matrix.C-state-machine: state-machine attacker: find dangerous call/state sequences and illegal transitions
trajectory_matrix.D-attacker: privileged actor: assume the attacker holds each realistic role and abuse it
trajectory_matrix.E-historical: historical analog: find variants of known exploits, patches and disclosures
trajectory_matrix.F-integration: adversarial integrator: assume every external contract/token behaves unexpectedly
trajectory_matrix.G-drift: spec drift: spec vs implementation vs deployment vs config divergence
trajectory_matrix.H-lifecycle: consensus/lifecycle game: model the full commit→challenge→finalize (or propose→vote→execute) game and the adversary WINNING it — a valid transition proven from an invalid claimed root, a challenge that never fires, a finalization that can be blocked
